summary: Executed backend regression coverage and browser checks for FibraZ authentication, dashboard, clients, billing, plans, routers, and supporting modules.

critical.issue: New ticket creation returns 422 because TicketModel requires ticket_number, while the endpoint generates it server-side. The frontend form does not send ticket_number, so the Tickets create flow is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend submits the ticket form without ticket_number and receives 422 from backend.

action_items: Make TicketModel.ticket_number optional for POST creation (or use a separate create schema), then retest ticket create and resolve.
Replace allow_origins=['*'] with explicit frontend origin when allow_credentials=True.
Fix the malformed error-detection evaluate snippet in the browser test if rerunning that diagnostic (application UI itself passed).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is configured with wildcard origin and allow_credentials=True; this is unsafe and browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests in some contexts.
Ticket creation schema conflicts with endpoint behavior: server-side ticket_number generation is unreachable because Pydantic validation happens first.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data intentionally created; test-created plan, inventory, ticket attempt, task, and hotspot data were cleaned where creation succeeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth with admin@fibraz.pe/admin123, auth/me, dashboard summary, catalog reads, router ping/interfaces, client toggle, UI login/navigation/ping/billing passed. Ticket create is blocked by 422 before persistence; payment, receipt modal, ticket resolve, and several CRUD UI flows remain to be retested after schema fix.
rca of the issue: TicketModel declares ticket_number: str as required, but create_ticket assigns it only after model validation. POST /api/tickets therefore rejects the frontend payload with a missing-field 422. Use an input schema where generated fields are optional/excluded from create validation.
